QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] A Personal Visit
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've returned with the full bottle, talk to the #b#p1501004##k again.
QuestInfo.1: The #b#p1501004##k said she needs to meet the #b#p1501003##k face to face if she's going to teach him how to sing. You'll have to go back to #b#m101082000##k and deliver the message.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the message to #b#p1501001##k. What will she need next?

1.msg: Ah... She's worried about me? How sweet. Ruenna's such a nice girl.

2.msg: But what's this about teaching someone to sing?

4.msg: Anything for Ruenna. But I'll need to meet this aspiring vocalist face-to-face if I'm going to teach him to sing.

0.msg: Maybe that little bird isn't so desperate after all...
Hm? You already spoke with the Shimmer Songbird?
It's something that can only be taught in person.
